title: Re: Tomb-land Security - Level 6
description: Re: Tomb-land Security - Level 6 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ticked Tomb Curator

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 10 Tomblifters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ticked Tomb Curator

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 10 Tomblifters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

I need you to keep up your patrol in hopes of curbing the amount of Tomblifters that loiter in the tomb. Basically we have to keep up the pressure on them so they become uncomfortable and insecure and decide they would rather spend time in their bedrooms playing video games instead of hanging out in the tomb. Consider that your mission statement!

Continue your patrols into the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist in Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag. I need you to slay 10 of the Tomblifters there to make it clear to these tomb rats that there presence in the tomb is not acceptable and that well-adjusted members of the server are welcome, but no-good punks like them are not! When you have slain 10 of the Tomblifters I want you to return to me, the Ticked Tomb Curator, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Was your quest successful? Don't let them calling you a 'sellout' get to you, they are just trying to get to you. Good job.

Objectives:

  • Slay Tomblifters

Client level range: 88–91
